# openwrt_network_globals (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt network global settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `packet_steering` (Boolean) Enable packet steering across CPU cores.
- `ula_prefix` (String) IPv6 ULA prefix (e.g., 'fda1:b7f5:46f7::/48').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: network/globals.
